sentences.text: Kusum & Ors. vs . Sh. Amandeep Garg & Ors. on 12 November,

2024 
Author: Jyotsna Rewal Dua
Bench: Jyotsna Rewal Dua
Kusum & Ors. Vs. Sh. Amandeep Garg & Ors.
Copc No.71 of 2024 12.11.2024 Present: Mr. Maan Singh, Advocate, for the petitioners.

Mr. Amandeep Sharma, Additional Advocate General with Mr. Sikander Bhushan, Deputy Advocate
General, for the respondents.
This contempt petition has now appeared for the fourth time without there being any compliance of the judgment on part of the respondents.

Directions in the judgment were to pay compensation to the petitioners in terms of the Negotiated Award No.1/2019 passed on 11.06.2019 with all statutory benefits under the Land Acquisition Act within eight weeks from 04.07.2023.
The land in question was to be deemed to have been acquired for the construction of the road in question.
It is not in dispute that the Letters Patent Appeal against the aforesaid judgment was dismissed on 25.05.2024.

In the Special Leave Petition instituted by the respondents,
the operation of the judgment has not been stayed.
Faced with the above, learned Deputy Advocate General seeks four days' time to have instructions in the matter positively for complying with the decision.
Jyotsna Rewal Dua  November 12, 2024 Judge  Mukesh Kusum & Ors. vs . Sh. Amandeep Garg & Ors.
